AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R19-17
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O19-737
CALL TO ORDER

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 14)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.

Demands

Monthly Investment Transaction Report - April 30, 2019
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
4.
Third Quarter Financial Report March 31, 2019
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
5.
Receive and File the Appointment of the City Treasurer, Law Enforcement Services Special Tax Oversight Committee, Finance Advisory Committee, Technology Advisory Committee, Parklands Committee, Traffic Safety Committee and Planning Commission and the Mayor’s Appointments of Committee and Commission Chairpersons and Vice Chairpersons
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council “receive and file” the list of appointments listed herein to the City Treasurer, Law Enforcement Services Special Tax Oversight Committee, Finance Advisory Committee, Technology Advisory Committee, Parklands Committee, Traffic Safety Committee and Planning Commission, and “receive and file” the report relative to the Mayor’s appointments for Chairperson and Vice Chairperson.
Staff Report
6.
Approval of Resolution R19-13 of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates, California Adjusting the FY 18-19 Budget to Appropriate Funds for Video Services for the June 11, 2019, City Council Workshop and Appropriation of Funds Thereof
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council appropriate the funding to webcast and video the June 11, 2019, City Council Workshop.
Staff Report
7.
Special Event Application for the Lunada Bay Homeowners Association’s “Summer Concerts in the Park” on June 2, June 23, July 28, August 11, August 25, at Lunada Bay Park
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Special Event Application and request to post signs for the annual “Summer Concerts in the Park” at Lunada Bay Park on Sundays, June 2nd, June 23rd, July 28th, August 11th, and August 25th, 2019.
Staff Report
8.
Special Event Application and Request to Post Signs/Flags for the Annual Palos Verdes Independence Day Celebration on Thursday, July 4, 2019 at the Malaga Cove School Grounds from 7:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Special Event Application and request to post signs/flags for the annual Palos Verdes Independence Day Celebration at the Malaga Cove School grounds on Thursday, July 4, 2019 from 7:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Staff Report
9.
Receive and File the City Council Liaison Appointments to the Finance Advisory Committee and the City Treasurer to Serve as an Additional Non-Voting Ex-Officio Member
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
10.
Annual Rate Adjustment for Refuse Collection by Athens Services (FY 19-20)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council "receive and file" Athens Services’ letter dated April 26, 2019, requesting a 2.6% increase for single family service and a 2.64% increase for 3 Yard Bins, 10 and 30 Yard Roll-Offs; acknowledging the rate adjustment as of July 1, 2019, as authorized by the existing agreement.
Staff Report
11.
PW 668-18; Completion of Construction Contract for the Via Anacapa Sidewalk/Curb Café Extension at Lunada Bay and Miscellaneous Sidewalk Removal and Replacement at Various Locations and Filing of Notice of Completion
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept as complete construction contract PW 668-18 Via Anacapa Sidewalk/Curb Café Extension at Lunada Bay and Miscellaneous Sidewalk Removal and Replacement at Various Locations Project in the amount of $153,350; and direct the City Clerk’s office to file the Notice of Completion and release the 5% retention 30 days after the County Recorder's office records the Notice of Completion, if no stop notices are filed.
Staff Report
12.
Resolution R19-14 - Congestion Management Plan (CMP) Opt-Out
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution R19-14 electing to be exempt from the CMP in accordance with the CMP statute.
Staff Report
13.
Receive and File the City of Palos Verdes Estates Quarterly Newsletter Suggested Topics – Summer 2019 Issue
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council “receive and file” the suggested topics listed herein of the upcoming City of Palos Verdes Estates Quarterly newsletter – Summer Issue.
Staff Report
14.
Approval of Agreement for Interim City Manager Services
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Agreement for Interim City Manager Services (Attachment A).
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S)
15.
Resolution R19-15: Adopting a Comprehensive Fee Schedule Establishing and Amending Certain Service and Development-Related Fees for City Services for Fiscal Year 2019-2020
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution R19-15 adopting a comprehensive fee schedule establishing and amending certain service and development-related fees for city services for Fiscal Year 2019-2020.
Staff Report
16.
Request to Appeal Planning Commission Approval of NC-1635/G-1623-18; Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading Permit for the Construction of a New Single-Family Residence Located at 629 Via Del Monte. Lot 8, Block 1615, Tract 6884. (Resolution No. PCR-2018-1096) (This Project is Exempt From the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.) Recommendation: Continued to June 11, 2019.

OLD BUSINESS

Fire Safety Weed Abatement Program
Recommendation: Receive & File.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
18.
Infrastructure Management Plan and Adoption of Resolution R19-16 for Budget Appropriation Thereof
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution R19-16 appropriating $57,500 of unallocated CIP fund balance and authorize staff to direct HR Green to prepare the Infrastructure Management Plan.
Staff Report
19.
Consideration of Calendaring Finance Advisory Committee and / or Finance Director Reports to the City Council on the Agendas of Regular Meetings Routinely
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss and determine if additional financial reports and/or status updates are needed at this time.
Staff Report
20.
Review and Approval of Palos Verdes Beach and Athletic Club FY 2019-20 Operating and Capital Budgets
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the FY 2019-20 Palos Verdes Beach and Athletic Club proposed operating and capital budgets.
Staff Report
21.
Merchant Account Processor Services
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the enrollment into Elavon’s Credit Card Cost Control (C4) program further saving the city approximately $10,200. If approved, notification of the new merchant established card fee will be posted at the counter.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
i.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, report on community activities and ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, MAY 29, 2019, AT 8:00 A.M. AT THE PALOS VERDES GOLF CLUB FOR THE PURPOSE OF WORKSHOP.
